pages.quiz:
GEOGRAPHY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   D. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.

2. Which statement about Weather is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Weather with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Weather as rumours only.
   C. Say Weather never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Weather.

3. Which statement about Vegetation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Vegetation as rumours only.
   B. Say Vegetation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation.
   D. Explain Vegetation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Littering in markets

5. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   D. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Climate is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Climate.
   B. Explain Climate with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Climate as rumours only.
   D. Say Climate never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   B. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   D. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Mass Wasting is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Mass Wasting as rumours only.
   B. Explain Mass Wasting with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Mass Wasting never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Mass Wasting.

9. Which statement about Weathering is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Weathering with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Weathering.
   C. Say Weathering never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Weathering as rumours only.

10. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

11. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Name the president
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

12. Which statement about Water Cycle and Action of Rivers is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Water Cycle and Action of Rivers never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Water Cycle and Action of Rivers with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Water Cycle and Action of Rivers as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Water Cycle and Action of Rivers.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Climate and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Vegetation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Weathering and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Mass Wasting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

3. D — Explain Vegetation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. B — Explain Mass Wasting with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. D — Plan income and spending wisely

11. D — Explain symbols used on a map

12. B — Explain Water Cycle and Action of Rivers with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
